result.topic_en: Calculations integrating the linear system dρ/dt = rρ' − qρ'', dρ'/dt = −rρ + pρ'', dρ''/dt = qρ − pρ' (rotation equations) using complex exponential solutions with null-vector conditions, followed by the special case of constant p, q with explicit trigonometric solutions.

methods.what: Linear rotation system for direction quantities with angular velocities p,q,r
First integrals: sum of squares and scalar product with (g,h,k) constant
Complex null-vector solutions orthogonal to (g,h,k), ratios expressed via g,h,k and ϖ
Logarithmic derivative giving ρ by quadrature
Explicit solution for k=r=0 and constant p,q: rotation with frequency sqrt(p^2+q^2)
Real direction cosines from the solution
